title: Yoisaki Kanade — The Stranger In The Mirror〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... That company's website should be... Oh, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh, they even have products exclusive to the online store.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I probably never would've thought to buy clothes from an outdoors retailer if Tenma hadn't suggested it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Aside from clothes, they have a wide selection of accessories and outdoor goods. Sleeping bags, portable lamps...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm seeing so many new things since I don't normally look at these kinds of sites...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line: Kanade, can I come in...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, yes. Come in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What do you want to do about dinner...?
I can heat some food up for you if you're hungry.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's already time for dinner...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I am feeling hungry.
I'll lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you going camping, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Camping?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's the website for a famous outdoor goods company.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
No, I don't plan on going camping.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tenma told me about this company the other day is all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I decided to take a look at what other products they have, and got a bit carried away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I never realized how impressive outdoor products are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only are they durable, they're also incredibly well designed. For example, these shoes...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: These shoes? They look like hiking boots...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's supposed to be very easy to tackle trails in the mountains with them because the soles are so sturdy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which made me think that I wouldn't become as tired if I wore a pair of these whenever I went out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're usually in an urban environment, Kanade, so I'm not sure these would help...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They wouldn't?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, because how thick the soles of your shoes need to be will change depending on whether you're walking paved roads or a rocky trail.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If anything, boots this sturdy may end up feeling really heavy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, if you're curious, you could try a pair on at one of their shops. They may even carry some lighter shoes that you find more comfortable to walk in.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it might be good to go...
Especially if a new pair will make my walks easier...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, this hat also caught my eye.
It's apparently called a “safari hat”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've seen these before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Explorers in movies always have these on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought it'd be nice to have one of these handy for those really sunny days.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it has a wide brim, so it probably is good at blocking the sun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Oh, this backpack also seemed useful...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now it sounds like you're going mountain climbing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mountain climbing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose it would seem that way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is this weird...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know... At the very least, you'd stand out while walking around the city.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... But these all seem handy and comfortable...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess I wouldn't mind standing out a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you're comfortable with that, then you should get them...
